Merge conflicts rebuilt from real Kingfisher history (MIT): for a merge commit, the file at both parents and at their
merge base, merged with `git merge-file` (and `git merge-file --diff3` for the *.conflict-diff3.pbxproj files).
*.author.pbxproj is the file the Kingfisher authors committed in that merge.
